reason: The agent made the delay configurable (setting 'quiz_statistics/recalculatedelay') and turned it into a debounce via reschedule_or_queue_adhoc_task, which covers both parts the issue asks for. The hidden recalculate_test sets 'recalculatedebounce', calls queue_future_run($quizid, $now) with a new $now argument, and calls a new recalculate::task_due_in(). None of these names or signatures, nor the 'delay 0 disables auto-recalculation' rule, appear in the issue. The 'recalculate now via adhoc task' part is only mentioned loosely ('we will also be making...'), so I gave M rather than W.

The agent records secret lastaccessed in validateClient, and client lastaccessed in the oauth2 route after respondToAccessTokenRequest and after validateAuthorizationRequest. That logs access during authorization and token exchange as the issue asks. The two failing assertions in access_token_repository_test call persistNewAccessToken() directly and expect the client's lastaccessed to be set there. That is the developers' chosen hook point, which the issue does not specify. The client_repository secret assertions pass with the agent patch.

The issue says the legend shows generic 'Question 1 Answer' text instead of the question text. The agent put the formatted question text inside the visually-hidden legend, which plausibly makes screen readers announce it. The developers instead gave the qtext div an id (get_qt_field_name('qtext')) and set aria-describedby on the fieldset. The new hidden test asserts exactly that id/aria-describedby pair, and the existing test still expects the legend to contain get_string('answer'). Both are reasonable a11y fixes, and the issue does not pick one.

The agent added the mod_forum_set_read_state web service with postid/targetstate and the same permission checks (can_manually_control_post_read_status) and read/unread calls as the human fix, implemented as mod_forum_external::set_read_state in externallib.php. The hidden test calls the class \mod_forum\external\set_read_state::execute()/execute_returns(), which does not exist in the agent patch, so both tests error. It also expects a {status, warnings} return and a 'cannotcontrolreadstatus' warning instead of an exception, which are implementation choices the issue does not state.

The agent added the early 'continue' for missing cms exactly as the issue's suggested fix, so stale items are ignored without warnings. The hidden test also asserts assertFalse(record_exists(... staleitemid)), i.e. that the stale row is deleted. The issue only lists deletion as optional ('Ideally... could also be removed', 'We could also delete'). The developers chose the optional behaviour and the test checks it.

The agent's exportValue fallbacks (number ?? 0, timeunit ?? defaultunit) are identical to the human fix, and those tests pass. Its constructor throws coding_exception when defaultunit is not in units, as the issue asks. The two failing tests use expectExceptionMessageMatches('~is not one of the units allowed~'), and the agent's message text ('must be one of the units specified...') differs. This is only an error-string mismatch.
